about: Official logos bundled for the tool catalog, 64 px PNG. Each entry names the source it was fetched from on 2026-10-10 and a licence note. A tool with no entry keeps its letter tile. 'plate' is the backdrop a transparent logo needs to stay visible: 'light' for dark ink, 'dark' for light ink, 'none' for an opaque square.
